fingerprint: workspace GET returns newer bytes while the selected Monaco model retains the previous clean version
symptom: Disk bytes and diagnosis refresh, but Monaco sometimes retains the prior saved text.
root_cause: Concurrent opens and reuse of explicit-selection mode changes allowed stale identity or an unintended view transition during external synchronization.

baseline.expected: server returns external-clean while editor still shows valid true

failure_baseline.expected: external-clean response with stale valid true editor

success_baseline.expected: direct and indirect sync plus dirty preservation pass

fix: Use monotonically increasing open identities, clean-baseline revalidation, server-byte ownership for clean sync, and preserve the current view mode.
steps: inspect response payload and editor state
separate request, content and view ownership
rollback: Return to the event-to-open projection owner and invalidate browser evidence if any stale or destructive sync recurs.
exit_criteria: direct disk bytes appear within the bounded watcher interval
known_issue_regressions: late old GET overwrites new response
programmatic Monaco update creates a ghost draft
background sync changes edit mode to run mode
writeback: configuration-workbench.md records source projection and view-mode ownership separately.
